_README: Pre-approval allowlist for the pipeline-capture skill. Copy the `permissions` block into the VC's `.claude/settings.json` in the folder where they run the skill (create the file if absent). This lets the ~hundreds of connector + local calls run WITHOUT a permission prompt on each one. IMPORTANT: the three MCP server names below (Gmail / Google_Calendar / Google_Drive) must match how the connectors are actually registered on the VC's machine — confirm during setup. If they differ, run the 3-month validation scan once and approve each tool with 'Yes, and don't ask again for this tool'; those approvals carry the full run prompt-free even without this file.
